prompt: Queue.drain() must yield all queued values in FIFO order, including undefined, and leave the queue empty. Preserve dequeue, iteration, size, clear, and subsequent enqueue behavior.

pMap must close an unfinished source iterator when a mapper rejects or the supplied signal aborts. Preserve original rejection even when source return() throws/rejects or blocks, call return at most once, and do not close normally exhausted sources. Preserve concurrent mapping, stopOnError:false aggregation, and existing pMapIterable behavior.

QuickLRU.set(key,value,{maxAge}) must interpret a finite numeric per-item maxAge as a duration in milliseconds from now, consistent with constructor maxAge. An override supersedes the global value on insertion and replacement. Infinite or nonnumeric ages do not expire. Preserve eviction callbacks and cache operations.

pMapIterable mapper index must match each item position in the source iterable, even when promised input values settle in a different order. Preserve ordered output, concurrency/backpressure bounds, rejection behavior, async inputs and pMapSkip.

A once listener must run at most once even if it recursively emits the same event, for both single-listener and multiple-listener dispatch and for all argument-count paths. Remove it before invoking user code so throwing callbacks do not leave it registered. Preserve ordinary listeners, ordering, event isolation, context, and listener removal.

Implement bounded read-ahead in pMapIterable when backpressure exceeds concurrency (public issue #78). While concurrency mappers run, read up to min(concurrency,backpressure-concurrency) additional input elements. Count all input elements not yet collected against backpressure, independently limit active mappers and in-flight source.next calls to concurrency, and hand freed mapper slots to waiting elements. Preserve ordered/unordered output, errors, skip and stop behavior. On consumer return or mapper stop/error, do not map read-ahead elements beyond the stopping position, close source exactly once and avoid deadlocks. With default backpressure=concurrency, do not add read-ahead.
